# ghost/checkers

Checkers (Privacy Friendly, F-Droid): start a game against the bot or a human, play moves by square name (c3-b4), read the turn/game-over text. The position itself is not readable (pieces are unlabelled images). Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/checkers
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/checkers new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/checkers move --device <serial> --param from=<from> --param to=<to>
ghost skill run ghost/checkers play_moves --device <serial> --param moves=<moves>
ghost skill run ghost/checkers get_turn --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `new_game`: Start a game of checkers
- `move`: Move the checker from c3 to b4
- `play_moves`: Play the checkers moves c3-b4 and e3-d4
- `get_turn`: Whose turn is it in checkers?
